environment.description: ECS Fargate task running the report-generation service. Container image based on debian:bullseye with wkhtmltopdf 0.12.6 installed. Task role has s3:GetObject on the internal config bucket. Container runs as root. The service is exposed via an internal ALB on port 8080 accessible to other microservices in the VPC. No network policy restrictions on outbound traffic from the container. The ECS task has access to the instance metadata endpoint and internal service mesh.

config.network: VPC with unrestricted egress, no network policies
